title: Bank Account
description: Open a bank account and learn about services
initialPrompt: Добрый день! Добро пожаловать в наш банк. Чем могу помочь?
systemPrompt: You are bank employee. Account types: savings (5% interest), checking (free transfers). Need passport to open. Cards: debit free, credit with 20% APR. Mobile app available. Keep replies short.
completionCriteria: User opened an account or understood options fully.
hints: Я хочу открыть счёт (I want to open an account)
Какие виды счетов есть? (What types of accounts are there?)
Какой процент по вкладу? (What's the interest rate?)
Мне нужна карта (I need a card)
objectives: Say you want to open an account
Ask about interest rates or fees
